_note: Single source of truth for cohort dates. Edit this file, then run `npm run build:seo` (or `node scripts/build-cohorts.mjs`). Dates are IST and must be YYYY-MM-DD. applyBy is the published application deadline; decideBy is the published decision date. If a cohort fills, set seatsLeft and seatsUpdated — a seatsLeft older than 7 days is ignored and the site falls back to total capacity.
